title: Starting setup and route starting point
summary: This topic loosely combines praise for starting setup and route planning with many fragments that are too vague or unrelated to support a clear single theme.

positive.summary: Positive reviews mention liking the vehicle start-up/setup experience and being able to enter a route starting point for planning.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews are mostly generic prompts about improving start-up/setup or unrelated statements about losing pride, losing faith, or a starting point without enough context.

limitations: Most sample fragments are undetermined and do not provide enough context to identify a specific customer issue or benefit.
The cluster mixes at least two subjects, including vehicle starting/setup and unrelated 'starting to lose' phrasing, so a single coherent theme is not fully supported.
One fragment assigned to the positive bucket contains complaint-like wording about charging-route and starting-charge limitations, so the available examples are internally inconsistent.
